# The original checkbox row names its twisty separately from its checkbox label

At the owned revision, the twisty button is a sibling of the label that wraps the visible name span and checkbox. fillRow explicitly assigns the twisty's ariaLabel from viewRow.texts.name; the assignment already exists in the original class at line 99 and remains in accepted source. Removing the table cell's ariaLabel therefore does not mean the button loses its explicit name source. The exact markup and property assignments are verified; native accessible-name resolution and screen-reader behavior are not. This is not a general instruction to remove row/cell ARIA.

Scope: Checkbox tree concrete label sources.
